Extract total biomass of each functional group from Atlantis outputs

extract_biomass_main.Rd

Reads the biomass of each active functional group either from the main output NetCDF file (<group>_N variables converted to tonnes wet weight with calculate_biomass) or from the <prefix>_OUTBiomIndx.txt text output.

Usage

extract_biomass_main(path, prefix = NULL, fg.file, txt = F, dt.timeserie = NA)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the directory containing Atlantis outputs.

prefix

Character. Prefix of the Atlantis configuration (e.g. "AMPS").

fg.file

Character. Path to the functional groups CSV file.

txt

Logical. If FALSE (default) read from NetCDF; if TRUE read from <prefix>_OUTBiomIndx.txt.

dt.timeserie

Integer. When txt = TRUE, number of most recent time steps to retain. Use NA (default) to keep all rows.

Value

A named list with one element per functional group. Each element is a numeric vector of total biomass (tonnes wet weight), one value per time step.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  biomass <- extract_biomass_main(
    path    = "path/to/atlantis/outputs",
    prefix  = "AMPS",
    fg.file = "PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups.csv"
  )
} # }
